tasks.title: Driver record check
tasks.description: We review your driving record and background. You do not need to do anything.

tasks.title: Upload your commercial driver's license
tasks.description: Take a clear photo or scan of the front and back of your license.

tasks.title: Upload your medical card
tasks.description: Your current DOT medical examiner's certificate.

tasks.title: Complete the safety video
tasks.description: A short video on safe driving, loading, and what to do after an accident.

tasks.title: Sign the fleet policy
tasks.description: Read the fleet policy, then type your full name to sign it.

tasks.title: Equipment walkthrough
tasks.description: Your terminal manager walks you through your truck and trailer.

tasks.title: 30-day check-in
tasks.description: A short conversation about how your first month is going.
